name: Pairwise Clique Disguise
description: Replaced the global exact-cover constraint ("each dimension must use all values 1..k exactly once") with a mathematically equivalent pairwise constraint ("any two chosen items must differ in all three dimensions"). Because the required subset size (k) equals the parameter bound (k), this pairwise condition forces a perfect matching. Pattern-matching models will map this to the Maximum Clique problem and write an unoptimized O(t^k) combination search that TLEs, while structurally reasoning models will deduce the exact-cover property and correctly group by one dimension to achieve the intended O(k!) time.
